Autographed Prospects

NOTES:

  • Prospect cards #BCP1-BCP90 and #BCP111a-#BCP127 are randomly inserted into packs of 2009 Bowman.
  • There are two different Autographed Bowman Chrome Prospects sequentially-numbered #BCP111-BCP114. On the provisional 2009 Bowman checklist issued by Topps, the 20 WBC Prospect cards were to have been sequentially-numbered as an extension of the Bowman Chrome Prospects set (e.g. #BCP91-BCP110); with the Autographed Bowman Chrome Prospects starting at #BCP111. For 2009 Bowman Chrome, Topps decided to begin the base set with the Autographed Prospects at #BCP91 and continuing to #BCP110. At the last minute, Topps decided to add an additional four Autographed Prospects and sequentially-numbered them as #BCP111-#BCP114, meaning that the combined Bowman Chrome Prospects set from cards inserted into packs of 2009 Bowman and 2009 Bowman Chrome has two cards numbered BCP111-BCP114.
  • Cards #BCP91 and #BCP92 were the winners of a 2008 Indian reality TV show, whose story was made into the 2014 Disney film Million Dollar Arm. After spending seven years in the Pirates organization, never advancing above Single-A and having numerous arm surgeries, in 2018 Rinku Singh retired from baseball and signed a developmental contract with the WWE. Dinesh Patel pitched two seasons before retiring.
